name: ATCC 1754 PETC medium (basal mineral salts + yeast extract + trace elements + vitamins + reducing agent) (PMC3925604)
description: ATCC 1754 PETC medium (basal mineral salts + yeast extract + trace elements + vitamins + reducing agent), medium reported in PMC3925604, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC3925604 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: "a medium containing mineral salts, vitamins, and trace metals from ATCC 1754 PETC" for Clostridium ljungdahlii, described as "a strictly anaerobic acetogen"; basal medium per 1.0 L: NH4Cl 1.0 g, KCl 0.1 g, MgSO4·7H2O 0.2 g, NaCl 0.8 g, KH2PO4 0.1 g, CaCl2·2H2O 20.0 mg, yeast extract 1.0 g, plus 10 mL each of trace-element, vitamin, and reducing-agent solutions; grown on synthesis gas (CO, CO2, H2

Yeast extract.citation: Yeast extract supplies free amino acids, B-vitamins (thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, pantothenate, pyridoxine, folate, biotin, B12), nucleotides and minerals. Source: BD Bionutrient Technical Manual (3rd ed.); Atlas RM, Handbook of Microbiological Media (CRC Press, 4th ed. 2010).

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
